scene: A welder arc-welding a steel beam wearing only a t-shirt and no welding helmet or face shield, bright sparks, cardboard boxes stacked nearby.
A worker standing on the top step of a tall A-frame ladder next to a roof edge about 4 meters high, no harness, no hard hat.
An electrician without gloves or safety glasses working inside an open electrical cabinet full of cables, panel door open, no lockout tag.
A pedestrian in plain clothes, no hard hat, walking directly in front of a moving forklift inside a warehouse aisle.
Construction workers without hard hats standing directly underneath a steel beam suspended from a crane.
A worker climbing down into an open sewer manhole alone, no harness, no tripod, no gas detector, no attendant.
A factory walkway with a large oil spill, tangled extension cords across the floor and scattered tools, a worker walking through it.
A warehouse worker bending forward at the waist with straight legs and a rounded back to lift a heavy box from the floor, no gloves.
A welder wearing a welding helmet, leather gloves and flame-resistant jacket welding a pipe, a fire extinguisher and welding screen beside him, clean floor.
A worker on a scaffold platform with full guardrails and toe boards, wearing a hard hat, hi-vis vest and harness with lanyard clipped to the guardrail.
An electrician in arc-flash face shield, insulated gloves and FR clothing next to a de-energized electrical panel with a red lockout padlock and tag on the breaker.
A warehouse with a forklift in a marked lane and a pedestrian in hi-vis vest and hard hat walking behind a yellow steel barrier in a separate walkway.
Two construction workers wearing hard hats, hi-vis vests, safety glasses, gloves and safety boots reviewing drawings on a tidy site.
A confined-space entry at a manhole with a rescue tripod and winch, an attendant holding a gas detector, the entrant wearing a harness, respirator and hard hat.
A clean organised factory floor with painted walkways, tools on shadow boards, an operator in safety glasses, ear protection and safety shoes at a machine with guards in place.
